text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(My body... is burning hot...
Could this be...
the power of the Three Goddesses...?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............Heh.
As expected of the umamusume's
"Ancestors"...
Mysterious indeed are their ways.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I offer my deepest thanks,
O Three Goddesses.
With this power...
I swear I shall fulfill our long-cherished
desire.
